description.html: At 55 cm, this is the tallest model on the 30x30 cm base. The volume is about 49.5 liters. The extra 5 cm compared with the 30x30x50 usually goes to deeper substrate and a drainage layer, so the animal is left with a full half meter above the soil. The 3D background follows the entire height.

Crested and gargoyle geckos use every centimeter of height: they jump from branch to branch and sleep near the top. Green anoles look for a warm spot under the lamp and cooler leaves lower down, which this range of height allows. With tree frogs, the substrate layer retains moisture and the mesh vents carry away the excess.

If you need a wider base for a pair of geckos, look at the 45x35x80 or 45x40x70. The shape of the background, rock or bark, is agreed before the build. A terrarium to your dimensions is ready in 7 to 14 days. You choose the outer film from 34 patterns, and we ship it by courier.
